description.value: La Belle Patate has been serving authentic Québécois poutine on Vancouver's Davie Street since December 2009, offering over 40 varieties made with hand-cut fries and fresh cheese curds. Beyond poutine, the menu includes Montréal smoked meat sandwiches, authentic steamed hot dogs (steamies), and Canadian beer — a hearty fuel stop for cyclists passing through the West End. The restaurant has indoor seating and is wheelchair accessible.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is comprehensive and well-structured. The location page confirms the address (1215 Davie St, V6E 1N4) and provides a phone number (604-569-1215) absent from OSM. The home page explicitly states 'we do NOT have any Vegan, Halal or Gluten Free dishes' while also noting the gravy is vegetarian-friendly and a vegetarian poutine exists on the menu. Bike parking, washrooms, water refill, and Wi-Fi are not mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: Phone number (604-569-1215) is present on the website but missing from OSM tags — OSM should be updated.
OSM name is 'La Belle Patate/Poutine' but the website consistently uses 'La Belle Patate Vancouver' — minor naming discrepancy.
No bike parking information available from any source; this is a required criterion that remains unverified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established, actively operating fast-food restaurant with a strong identity serving hearty, affordable meals on a busy cycling corridor in Vancouver's West End — a solid refuelling stop for touring cyclists.
